title: Brickbox
description: BrickBox is a captivating 2D puzzle game where players must strategically push a dime to a designated finish zone within a confined play area filled with brick walls. With intuitive grid-based mechanics and touch-based movement, BrickBox challenges players to think critically and maneuver skillfully through three uniquely designed levels. Objective: Push the diamond to the finish zone to complete each level. Challenges: Navigate through brick walls and obstacles that block the path to the finish zone.
instructions: Touch Controls Android iOS Arrowkeys PC Mac Controls Players can move up down left or right one cell at a time using touch controls - Touch click the grey area around the player to move - Use arrowkeys on keyboard
